To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FLC based PD controller is better than General PD Controller.
the FLC is more robust and has better performance in terms of settling time and overshoot than the general PD controller.
the FLC based on Mamdani type inference mechanism performs better than the FLC based Takagi Sugeno type inference mechanism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comparative study of the performance of Fuzzy Logic Controller on PD strategy and General PD Controller in terms of transient response specifications and robustness.
the performance of the FLC based on PD strategy and the general PD control strategy in terms of transient specifications for position control.
the performance comparison of Fuzzy Logic based PD controller and conventional PD controller in terms of transient response specifications for position of separately excited DC Servo motor.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Fuzzy Logic based PD control strategy has better performance than General PD controller.
Fuzzy Logic Control is a better option as compared to general control techniques in terms of transient response specifications for the control of DC servomotor.
FLC is more robust as well as more accurate as compared to the general PD controller.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Fuzzy Logic Control based on PD strategy can be used for position control of Separately Excited DC Servomotor with better performance as compared to general PID controller.
the FLC based on PD strategy and inference mechanism of Mamdani type is more effective than general PD controller and Takagi-Segeno type inference mechanism of FLC.
Fuzzy logic controller is better than general PD controller in terms of performance and robustness.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Fuzzy Logic Control can be applied on PD strategy to improve the performance of the system in terms of transient specifications and it can be used as an alternative to general PD control strategy for the position control of a DC motor.
FLC is more robust and has faster response as compared to conventional PD controller.
FLC is better as compared to general controller in terms of transient response specifications and robustness.
